summary: Quiet narrow street kerb, homes about 20 m away on this side, steep.
reasons: Homes about 20 m away, same side

best_section.where: Douglas Street east kerb, beside the shed and between the two houses

drivers.seclusion: Nearest dwellings about 19-20 m away on this side; houses within 6-7 m near the start and an apartment block 4 m away at the top.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed narrow street; cars park on the west kerb, so room on this side is tight.
drivers.convention: Cars park mainly on the opposite kerb; no signs and no sign of overnight vans.

flags: Steep: about 8% grade over best section (max 13.2% elsewhere)
Narrow street: little room beside the lane on this side
Dwellings 4-7 m from the kerb at each end
sun_shade: Part shaded by trees from the east; open to afternoon sun from the west.
